A '''repulsorlift regiment''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A repulsorlift regiment was comprised of three [[repulsorlift battalion]]s, an [[armor battalion]], and a [[regimental headquarters]].<ref name="ISB" />

Repulsorlift regiments could be augmented by the addition of three more repulsorlift battalions, and another armor battalion.<ref name="ISB2" />
